games.name: Write a Letter ❄️
games.desc:
A game about writing a letter, write one for your friend or a stranger. 
Save notes from other players in your own journal or explore all the locations and secret areas!

Emotes can be accessed at the top left corner of your screen, next to the chat button.
To access more emotes; use the scroll wheel under "Default."
While holding a note you can drop it by pressing 'Q' and show it to others by holding 'E'. To place a note on the walls press "R".

Gamepads are not fully supported and you might require a mouse & keyboard on console to access all features.

Experience the chaos of the storm like never before! In this immersive tornado game, you can shrink down to a miniature size and face extreme weather up close — or sit back and watch massive storm scenarios unfold from a safe distance.

🔸 Be a Mini Survivor: Dodge flying debris, take shelter, and try to survive as a tiny player in huge tornadoes!

🔸 Explore unique maps, experience dynamic weather systems, and unlock new perspectives with every supercell!

Can you withstand the fury of nature? Or will you be swept away?
